logger.doc:name: Log DB Connectivity Error
logger.message: #["[ERROR] Database connectivity failure | CorrelationId: " ++ correlationId ++ " | Error: " ++ error.description]

logger.doc:name: Log DB Query Error
logger.message: #["[ERROR] Database query execution failed | CorrelationId: " ++ correlationId ++ " | Error: " ++ error.description]

logger.doc:name: Log Batch Loading Error
logger.message: #["[ERROR] Batch loading phase failed | CorrelationId: " ++ correlationId ++ " | Error: " ++ error.description]

logger.doc:name: Log Expression Error
logger.message: #["[ERROR] DataWeave expression error | CorrelationId: " ++ correlationId ++ " | Error: " ++ error.description]

logger.doc:name: Log Timeout Error
logger.message: #["[ERROR] Operation timeout | CorrelationId: " ++ correlationId ++ " | Error: " ++ error.description]

logger.doc:name: Log Retry Exhausted
logger.message: #["[ERROR] Retry attempts exhausted | CorrelationId: " ++ correlationId ++ " | Error: " ++ error.description]

logger.doc:name: Log OS Key Not Found
logger.message: #["[WARN] Object Store key not found | CorrelationId: " ++ correlationId ++ " | Key: " ++ (error.errorMessage.payload default "unknown")]

logger.doc:name: Log Unhandled Error
logger.message: #["[ERROR] Unhandled error | CorrelationId: " ++ correlationId ++ " | ErrorType: " ++ error.errorType.identifier ++ " | Error: " ++ error.description]

logger.doc:name: Log DLQ Entry
logger.message: #["[INFO] Storing record to DLQ | CorrelationId: " ++ correlationId]

os:store.doc:name: Store to DLQ

logger.doc:name: Log DLQ Success
logger.message: #["[INFO] Record stored to DLQ successfully | CorrelationId: " ++ correlationId]

logger.doc:name: Log Batch Record Error
logger.message: #["[WARN] Batch record processing error | CorrelationId: " ++ correlationId ++ " | RecordId: " ++ (payload.id default "unknown") ++ " | Error: " ++ error.description]
